name: ogsm-online
description: Work with your OGSM.online plans, actions and comments from Claude, in one environment per conversation.
long_description: Connects Claude to the OGSM.online API v3 with your personal API tokens. Configure your OGSM.online environments (host + personal API token) in the extension settings. At the start of a conversation Claude asks which environment you mean and you type its host (or choose it in a picker where the app offers one); Claude never sees the list of configured environments, only learns the one you chose and works in it for the whole conversation. To work in another environment, start a new conversation. Read only tokens can only read; read and write tokens can also create and update actions, comments, objectives, goals, strategies, indicators and measurements.

env_1_host.title: Environment 1: host
env_1_host.description: OGSM.online environment, e.g. klant.ogsm.online or a dedicated server such as example.ogsm.online.

env_1_token.title: Environment 1: personal API token

tools.name: select_environment
tools.description: Let the user choose the OGSM.online environment for this conversation. Pass environment_session null the first time, without host. The user then picks the environment in a form of their own, or, if that form is not available, the result tells you to ask the user: then ask one short question in their language (e.g. "In welke OGSM.online-omgeving wil je werken?") without explaining why, wait for their answer and call again with host set to exactly what they typed. You do not see the options and never choose or suggest one. If this conversation already has an environment_session, pass it (it is then refused, as a conversation works in one environment only). Returns the chosen environment and the environment_session for every other tool.

tools.name: list_canvases
tools.description: List the OGSM canvases the user can see, with their team id and status (draft, active, archived).

tools.name: list_teams
tools.description: List the teams the user belongs to.

tools.name: list_users
tools.description: List the users in the user's teams (id, name, email address), e.g. to find an assignee id.

tools.name: list_statuses
tools.description: List the statuses an action can have (id, name, base list), for the list field of an action.

tools.name: list_actions
tools.description: List the actions visible to the user, optionally only those on one canvas.

tools.name: create_action
tools.description: Create an action on a canvas, optionally under a strategy (or under another action). The canvas and strategy can't be changed later. Progress, involved, recurring and custom fields can't be set. Needs a read and write token.

tools.name: update_action
tools.description: Update an action; only the fields passed change. label_ids replaces the whole set; send an HTML description back in full. A card can't be moved to another canvas or parent, nor deleted, via the API. Needs a read and write token.

tools.name: list_comments
tools.description: List the comments on a card.

tools.name: create_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a card. Needs a read and write token.

tools.name: update_comment
tools.description: Replace the content of a comment (own comment, or any as tenant admin); send the full HTML. Needs a read and write token.

tools.name: delete_comment
tools.description: Delete one of the user's own comments on a card. Needs a read and write token.

tools.name: list_objectives
tools.description: List the objectives visible to the user, optionally only those on one canvas.

tools.name: create_objective
tools.description: Create an objective on a canvas. An objective takes no parent. The canvas and parent can't be changed later. Needs a read and write token.

tools.name: update_objective
tools.description: Update an objective; only the fields passed change. label_ids replaces the whole set; send an HTML description back in full. A card can't be moved to another canvas or parent, nor deleted, via the API. Needs a read and write token.

tools.name: list_goals
tools.description: List the goals visible to the user, optionally only those on one canvas.

tools.name: create_goal
tools.description: Create a goal on a canvas. Optional parent_id: a goal on the same canvas, for a sub goal. The canvas and parent can't be changed later. Needs a read and write token.

tools.name: update_goal
tools.description: Update a goal; only the fields passed change. label_ids replaces the whole set; send an HTML description back in full. A card can't be moved to another canvas or parent, nor deleted, via the API. Needs a read and write token.

tools.name: list_strategies
tools.description: List the strategies visible to the user, optionally only those on one canvas.

tools.name: create_strategy
tools.description: Create a strategy on a canvas. A strategy takes no parent. The canvas and parent can't be changed later. Needs a read and write token.

tools.name: update_strategy
tools.description: Update a strategy; only the fields passed change. label_ids replaces the whole set; send an HTML description back in full. A card can't be moved to another canvas or parent, nor deleted, via the API. Needs a read and write token.

tools.name: list_indicators
tools.description: List the indicators visible to the user, optionally only those on one canvas.

tools.name: create_indicator
tools.description: Create an indicator on a canvas. parent_id is required: a strategy on the same canvas, or an indicator there for a sub indicator. The canvas and parent can't be changed later. Needs a read and write token.

tools.name: update_indicator
tools.description: Update an indicator; only the fields passed change. label_ids replaces the whole set; send an HTML description back in full. A card can't be moved to another canvas or parent, nor deleted, via the API. Needs a read and write token.

tools.name: list_objective_reports
tools.description: List the objective reports (traffic light, description and decision; kind current, aggregation, impose_down, imposed or target), optionally of one objective. Values and traffic lights are in the language of the environment.

tools.name: list_strategy_reports
tools.description: List the strategy reports (traffic light, description and decision; kind current, aggregation, impose_down, imposed or target), optionally of one strategy. Values and traffic lights are in the language of the environment.

tools.name: list_action_reports
tools.description: List the action reports (traffic light, progress, status, used budgets, description and decision; kind current, aggregation, impose_down, imposed or target), optionally of one action. Values and traffic lights are in the language of the environment.

tools.name: list_goal_reports
tools.description: List the goal reports (current and target value, traffic light, show_in_ogsm, description and decision; kind current, aggregation, impose_down, imposed or target), optionally of one goal. Values and traffic lights are in the language of the environment.

tools.name: list_indicator_reports
tools.description: List the indicator reports (current and target value, traffic light, show_in_ogsm, description and decision; kind current, aggregation, impose_down, imposed or target), optionally of one indicator. Values and traffic lights are in the language of the environment.

tools.name: create_goal_report
tools.description: Add a measurement to a goal. at is required; description, decision and kind can't be set. traffic_light: nl groen/oranje/rood, en green/amber/red; clear with "" or null, never "leeg". Needs a read and write token.

tools.name: update_goal_report
tools.description: Change a measurement of a goal; only the fields passed change. traffic_light: nl groen/oranje/rood, en green/amber/red; clear with "" or null, never "leeg". Needs a read and write token.

tools.name: delete_goal_report
tools.description: Delete a measurement of a goal. Needs a read and write token.

tools.name: create_goal_report_batch
tools.description: Create, update and delete up to 500 goal measurements in one asynchronous batch. Each operation: op create (goal_id, at, values), update (id, values) or delete (id). Returns the queued batch; poll get_goal_report_batch for the per-operation results. At most 5 batches per 5 minutes. traffic_light: nl groen/oranje/rood, en green/amber/red; clear with "" or null, never "leeg". Needs a read and write token.

tools.name: get_goal_report_batch
tools.description: Get the status (queued, processing, completed, failed) and per-operation results of one of the user's goal report batches.

tools.name: create_indicator_report
tools.description: Add a measurement to an indicator. at is required; description, decision and kind can't be set. traffic_light: nl groen/oranje/rood, en green/amber/red; clear with "" or null, never "leeg". Needs a read and write token.

tools.name: update_indicator_report
tools.description: Change a measurement of an indicator; only the fields passed change. traffic_light: nl groen/oranje/rood, en green/amber/red; clear with "" or null, never "leeg". Needs a read and write token.

tools.name: delete_indicator_report
tools.description: Delete a measurement of an indicator. Needs a read and write token.

tools.name: create_indicator_report_batch
tools.description: Create, update and delete up to 500 indicator measurements in one asynchronous batch. Each operation: op create (indicator_id, at, values), update (id, values) or delete (id). Returns the queued batch; poll get_indicator_report_batch for the per-operation results. At most 5 batches per 5 minutes. traffic_light: nl groen/oranje/rood, en green/amber/red; clear with "" or null, never "leeg". Needs a read and write token.

tools.name: get_indicator_report_batch
tools.description: Get the status (queued, processing, completed, failed) and per-operation results of one of the user's indicator report batches.
